name: Proshchalnoye pismo
source:
Several years ago, the protagonist lost his beloved girlfriend in a car crash, which put an end to his future life. He doesn't see himself in this world and decides on a desperate, selfish act that he believes will solve all his problems.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3036196123]Steam[/url]]
